args.lesson: What worked: staging the change outside products/sites/ while a review was pending, so the review digest stayed valid. Once the release was verified, applying the change took one hash-guarded copy (baseline asserted equal to the live release), followed by a dry_run (digest a34cf58c...). What failed: one EXEC wrote into a directory that was not in its fresh workspace without calling mkdir first. Always create parent directories. Next: get an independent non-claude review of the exact digest. The preview datalist omits 106518-2026; this is a known gap and not a defect. Synthetic checks are not demand evidence.
